Friendly staff. Dr. Dan is great with the animals. My dog loves going to see him.
I've been coming here for close to 18 years. The doctor is personable and reasonably priced as well.
Wonderful and caring doctor! We’ve been coming with Hugo for 7 years and always got very good treatment. Highly recommend!
The doctor was excellent with my dog. We've been going to him for 9 years.

My puppy had to come in today for his annual checkup and some shots. The doctor was very nice and actually cared about my puppy's well-being. He gave us some good advice about where we could take him for training and about how to avoid an ear infection. They were very gentle with my puppy, too, since he was very anxious. Very happy with how things went, I highly recommend them!
They have taken great care of our dog Roscoe for over 7 years now.
The vet and staff are amazing they take wonderful care of my pet Milo.
I love taking my dog to Dr Andy.  Great service
My dog was very comfortable. The doctor is very gentle and knowledgeable. I would recommend.
Amazing Clinic, Doctor and staff.
Great neighborhood vet
Just called here and the person that answered the phone was very short and rude.
Dr. Andy—the best vet I’ve ever dealt with. He’s so kind to the little ones in his charge as well as their families.

Dr. Andy is a great veterinarian. Everything I want: practical, compassionate, and accessible. Plus decades of experience. His "bedside manner" with both pets and humans is no doubt part of his success. I've had two dogs, one after the other with some overlap, and even after I moved out of the neighborhood into one with many other vets, I continue to drive the extra distance to him, because he's so great. He doesn't care about fancy marble countertops in the lobby. He cares about the animals, and he is reasonable.

This is one of the best vets in Chicago.  So good I don't want everyone to know because then it will be hard for me to get an appointment.  Now that's just selfish of me.  I have trusted this vet with my last 3 pets.  He's fantastic and very patient.
So nice to all the animals 💙. …

Great!! They are taking care of my dog, just what I have to. They are not just hard sell. And the heart worms pills cheaper than I bought in other stores. So I always bought for the whole year before I checked up my dog next year.

The doctor and staff were really nice and the clinic was clean. You can easily find a free parking spot in front of the clinic, too.
Very professional via phone. Have not been able to get an appointment, since they’re not taking any new patients right now but I will keep trying. They come highly recommended.
